## Objetivo
Establish the React/TypeScript/Vite and Express application skeleton, SQLite migration infrastructure and runnable fast/full test harness. Do not implement accounts, sessions, authentication UI or product schemas here. The approved Docker environment is provided separately and remains unchanged.

## Implementation notes
Create scripts: test (node --import tsx --test tests/unit/*.test.ts tests/api/*.test.ts), test:e2e (playwright test), typecheck (tsc --noEmit), build (vite build), dev (tsx server/index.ts), start (NODE_ENV=production tsx server/index.ts). Use the spec's exact dependency versions and commit the resolved lockfile. Configure Vite development middleware and production static hosting behind Express on 4173, honoring HOST and DB_PATH. Supply app factory, listener teardown, temporary-database helpers and migration tracking. The shell is a neutral infrastructure page, not a fake product feature. T08 adds account APIs; T10 adds account screens and shared product UI.

## Critérios de Aceitação
- [ ] npm ci --no-audit --no-fund, npm test, npm run typecheck, npm run build and npm test && npm run test:e2e work in the workspace. Unit/API infrastructure smoke tests exist. A manifest assertion rejects latest, caret, tilde, wildcard and range versions in direct dependencies. Prettier 3.6.2 is pinned as a dev dependency; .prettierignore excludes .nants/, .nants-outputs/, .sdd/ and generated directories. .gitignore excludes node_modules/, dist/, data/, test-results/, playwright-report/, coverage/ and local secrets.
- [ ] Database infrastructure tests apply a test migration twice and verify it is tracked exactly once, close and reopen a temporary database and retain a test row. Production initialization creates migration tracking without account/product schemas. Test helpers require an explicit isolated temporary database path and pass it to every test application instance; tests assert that the injected path is used and close all listeners/connections. The development database is not a deliverable and must not be accessed, created, modified or committed by these tests.
- [ ] Playwright 1.56.1 uses Chromium, isolated test data, reuseExistingServer:false and a webServer command that builds current sources then starts with HOST=127.0.0.1 on 4173. A neutral-shell smoke test passes at 1280x720 and 390x844. Shared helpers collect pageerror/console.error into failure messages, write text error-context.md on failure and capture descriptive viewport-only screenshots after scrolling to the relevant element. No fixed-time sleeps or pixel comparisons. No account setup or sign-in coverage is required until T10.

### Tentativa 2
Resumo do Desenvolvedor:
Implemented isolated Playwright database storage. Each run now gets a unique temporary SQLite path, and the directory is removed when the Playwright process exits.

The unit/API tests, typecheck, build, and full browser test command passed. The screenshot viewer had no captures available for inspection.

 ## Critérios
- npm ci, test commands, smoke tests, dependency pins, Prettier, and ignore rules: atendido: prior attempt reported `npm ci` passing; this run passed `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, and `npm test && npm run test:e2e`. Evidence: `tests/unit/infrastructure.test.ts`, `tests/api/application.test.ts`, `package.json`, `.prettierignore`, `.gitignore`.
- SQLite migration behavior, isolated test paths, and database cleanup: atendido: `tests/unit/infrastructure.test.ts`, `tests/helpers/application.ts`, `tests/api/application.test.ts`, `server/database.ts`.
- Playwright configuration, isolated data, browser smoke tests, and error evidence: atendido: `playwright.config.ts:6-13,38-42`; `tests/e2e/shell.spec.ts`. Both desktop and mobile smoke tests passed.

 ## Respostas aos apontamentos
- F-01: fixed: `playwright.config.ts:6-13,38-42` creates a unique temporary database directory per run, supplies its database path to the web server, and removes it when the process exits.

## Registro de Apontamentos
- id: F-01
  severity: MEDIUM
  location: playwright.config.ts:27
  description: The Playwright webServer uses the same fixed SQLite file for every run. Existing data can persist between runs, and concurrent runs can share or modify that database, so the required isolated test data is not ensured.
  recommendation: Give each Playwright run a unique temporary database path and clean it up after the run.
